The main takeaway from our work is that
NO3 is an important reservoir for the nighttime chemistry in the lower troposphere.
NO3 concentrations are much larger than previously thought and that NO3 is not confined to a very thin layer near the ground, but is distributed over a large part of the nocturnal boundary layer.
